full_judgment: 3. The learned counsel appearing for petitioner submits that the High Court Division did not at all consider the pertinent question that defendant No.9, Shahana Begum, died on 3.2.86 and summons of the suit was never served upon her and she never appeared in the suit and her heirs were also not brought on record within the statutory period of limitation and that above facts were not denied by the plaintiff Bank and further the High Court Division did not at all consider that Annexures-B(1) and 1(1) to the writ petition also showed that summons of the suit were never severed upon the defendant No.9 and in view of the above the provision of order 22 Rule 4 of the C.P.0 would not be applicable in the instant case and the High Court Division passed the impugned judgment and order in a very slipshod manner.
